g.text: IF YOU'RE SO SMART, WHY ARE YOU NOT — FIT / ATHLETIC · PART 3.1
Power · Speed · Agility — how fast you turn force on, not how much you have.
the only time you actually have
max strength raises the WHOLE curve ↑
ONE ENGINE — phosphagen system + Type IIx fibres
explosive force in place · force × velocity
power applied to locomotion · TWO skills
⚠ 5-10-5 = a CHANGE-OF-DIRECTION test, not agility (no reaction)
NEURAL NOTE: early gains are neural — recruit Type IIx + fire faster (rate coding), not new tissue.
tells you which tool you need
⚠ SAFETY INTERLOCK — PREREQUISITE GATE FOR HIGH-INTENSITY WORK
depth jumps · max sprints — gate must be OPEN
pogos · squat jumps · low box jumps — start today
⚠ several × bodyweight through joints in a fraction of a second — earn the right to be explosive.
— you can't express force you don't have.
DIAGNOSTIC: strength climbing but jumps/sprints flat?
→ you have force, not RATE — add full-intent explosive work.
